snippet.title: Brawl Stage Mods - WarioWare w/ Anti-Camping mechanics
snippet.description:
Wario Land competitively was reported as one of the worst stages to play on, due to camping issues. This proposed adjustments aims at making the stage keep its identity while tackling the platform problem.

Project M Nexus' VOD: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqfgpNbE128
